paragraphs: Kiro got home with the album under one arm.
After spending so much time around Susie, then Rin, the silence felt bigger than usual.
He closed the door behind himself.
Then looked down at the album.
He carried the album into the living room and placed it on the table.
The Halloween wrapping paper Rin had picked was beside it.
Kiro still thought it looked stupid.
Susie's photographs came back to him.
Her father asleep in a chair.
Pictures layered over pictures on her wall.
Things she apparently couldn't bring herself to throw away until someone else did it for her.
Kiro stopped somewhere near the middle.
His paw moved toward his pocket.
Standing beside the old railway tracks.
One ear turned slightly toward Susie because she had said something just before taking it.
That seemed even harder to admit.
Kiro looked back at the picture.
He didn't know why he had kept thinking about putting it in the album.
Instead, Kiro flipped somewhere into the middle.
He slid the Polaroid between two pages.
Wrapping it should have taken five minutes.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=reader]] “I know you're enjoying this.”
By the fourth attempt, pieces of ruined wrapping paper covered the floor.
Kiro had tape to one paw.
He pulled the tape off his fur.
Kiro placed it on the table.
For several minutes, he drank quietly.
Then his eyes moved toward the album again.

runs.text: What if she doesn't like it?
What if she thinks you tried too hard?

paragraphs: Kiro stared at the ruined wrapping paper around his feet.
He had known Susie for barely any time.

And somehow in those few days she had already slept against his shoulder, seen his scars, held him through a panic attack, walked through a forest with him, watched him disappear into something that wasn't there...
Kiro looked at the wrapped album.
He didn't use that word lightly anymore.
Not after learning how easily people could call themselves one.
Susie had earned it too quickly.
But it didn't make it less true.
Outside, wind moved through the trees.
Someone farther down the street had already put Halloween lights around their house.
A weak orange glow reached his window.
That should have solved the problem.

runs.text: What if she finds the photo?

paragraphs: That was why he put it there.

runs.text: You put yourself in her album.

paragraphs: Then he turned toward the wall.
Sleep finally came sometime much later.
For one confused second, he expected another sound.
His phone was beside the bed.
There wasn't too much to clean.
He reorganized three minerals on the windowsill.
Then moved one back because it looked wrong.
Found it cold twenty minutes later.
A few houses already had pumpkins near their doors.
Someone across the road was stretching fake cobwebs across a fence.
Another person was fighting with a plastic skeleton that refused to stay attached to a tree.
He looked toward the wrapped present on the table.
Then came back because he'd forgotten his phone.
Kiro glared at it like that was somehow its fault.
By early afternoon, the town was slowly changing.
Orange lights were being wrapped around railings and windows.
Someone carried two giant bags of candy from their car.
A father and his kid were trying to hang a ghost from a tree.
The ghost kept spinning around backwards.
His phone was in his paw.
Kiro stared at the empty text box.
[[message speaker=kiro to=susie]] happy birthday old woman
Picked it up again ten seconds later.
[[message speaker=kiro to=susie]] somehow you survived 25 years
Forgot the rest on the counter.
Checked the weather even though he wasn't planning anything weather-related.
The clock continued being a clock.
Outside, the daylight was already beginning to fade.
The sky turned from gray to darker gray.
House lights started appearing one by one.
Decorations became brighter as the natural light disappeared.
Kiro stood in front of the hallway mirror.
Fixed the front of his sweater.
Then immediately looked back and fixed his hair again.
Kiro caught you in the reflection.
At five, Kiro was completely ready.
Unfortunately, he still had to wait.
The television played something he hadn't followed for the last thirty minutes.
He threw his head against the back of the couch.
For some reason, he thought about the Polaroid hidden somewhere in the middle.
Rin stood near the fence with his hands in his hoodie pockets.
A proper gift bag hung from his other paw.
Cold air immediately hit his face.
Rin looked at Kiro's carefully wrapped present.
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “This is also a gift.”
Something small badly wrapped at the bottom.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “You don't even close the bag.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “So she doesn't see it.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “She's going to see it when she opens it.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “How long did yours take?”
At first, the streets were still relatively quiet.
Pumpkins glowed on a few porches now.
Orange lights reflected against the wet pavement.
Children could be seen through windows getting costumes on.
Kiro glanced toward one house where a tiny witch was arguing with someone near the door.
Kiro shoved his paws farther into his sleeves.
By the time they reached the busier residential streets, it was past five thirty.
The first groups of children were moving between houses.
Parents walked farther behind, already looking tired.
A tiny vampire ran directly toward Rin.
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “You're also a fucking animal.”
For a while, it was easy.
Rin occasionally reached into his gift bag and stole something.
Rin looked at the candy in his paw.
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “She doesn't know this was in there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “That's not how ownership works.”
Kiro still held the album with both paws.
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “You're carrying that thing like somebody's going to shoot it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “I don't want to crush it.”
Another group of children ran past.
Kiro watched them disappear around a corner.
Then looked down at the gift.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “What if she doesn't like it?”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “I was wondering how long you'd last.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “She has about eight million of them.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “You bought her somewhere to put them.”
Kiro wasn't sure what exactly he was afraid of.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “I know it's an album.”
After a moment, Rin spoke again.
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “You care whether she likes it.”
Something about the way he said it bothered Kiro.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “The one where you know something.”
The word came out quieter than everything around it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “That's not a nothing look.”

chapters.title: Gift
paragraphs: Warm air immediately replaced the cold.
Someone was talking in the kitchen.
A television played somewhere farther inside.
There were decorations along the hallway. Cheap orange lights. Paper bats. A plastic spider hanging from the ceiling badly enough that one leg kept falling down.
[[speech speaker=susie to=rin]] “Four people isn't a party.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro,rin]] “My dad. My aunt. Her boyfriend. And now you two.”
Kiro stayed near the door slightly too long.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You can take your jacket off.”
Kiro put the gift carefully on a small cabinet.
He almost hung it over a chair.
Susie pointed toward the hooks beside the door.
Then immediately looked back at the present.
Rin had already disappeared farther into the house.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Did he just leave us?”
Kiro grabbed the album again and followed.
He had been inside this house before.
Just Susie going upstairs to get her cameras.
Now there were coats near the entrance.
Kiro's body noticed all of it.
His tail stayed closer to his legs.
Susie slowed slightly when she noticed he wasn't beside her anymore.
She looked at the present against his chest.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Holding it like somebody's going to steal it.”
His claws were pressing lightly into the paper.
A few candles burned inside small pumpkin holders.
Someone had put a paper skeleton on the wall.
Then a man stepped out of the kitchen carrying a bowl.
He had seen him in photographs.
Same muted eyes, though his were more gray than green.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Kiro, this is my dad.”
Her father put the bowl down.
Her father held out a paw.
Martin noticed the wrapped rectangle in Kiro's other arm.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You haven't even given it to me yet.”
Rin appeared from the kitchen holding something in his mouth.
[[speech speaker=susie to=martin]] “I said he gets nervous sometimes.”
Kiro was still standing completely still.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Because people ask what I've been doing.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “Careful, Kiro. This is how social interaction works.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Would you prefer emotionally stable?”
Neither seemed especially interested in interrogating Kiro, which helped.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You met me because of Rin.”
Her aunt smiled in a way Kiro didn't like.
He sat near the end of the couch.
Susie sat on the floor near the coffee table.
Rin had somehow gotten the better chair despite not living there.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “Why are you sitting there?”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “Because I got here first.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “You came in after me.”
[[speech speaker=susie-aunt to=kiro,rin]] “Sorry. You two sound married.”
Susie laughed so hard she had to put her glass down.
Her paper crown had shifted even farther to one side.
He smiled before he could stop himself.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “It's barely on your head.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Doesn't make it less stupid.”
Susie adjusted even worse on purpose.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Now you're doing that to annoy me.”
It gave Kiro something to do with his paws.
Something to look at when conversation moved somewhere he didn't understand.
Susie's aunt told a story about Susie getting drunk at nineteen and throwing up into somebody's decorative plant.
[[speech speaker=susie-aunt to=all]] “It wasn't even a real plant.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=susie-aunt]] “That somehow makes it worse.”
[[speech speaker=martin to=susie]] “You put it in the bathtub.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You don't get to judge me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You climbed onto a roof during a thunderstorm.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You didn't need to share that.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=all]] “...one of my best decisions.”
Nobody was drunk enough to change the air.
Nobody seemed to be waiting for someone else to become dangerous.
Rin stealing snacks from Susie's plate when she wasn't looking.
Martin noticing and moving the entire bowl away from him.
That was worse in a different way.
Kiro looked down at his paws.
For a second, another table tried to appear.
That old warning inside his chest.
Kiro pressed his thumb against his palm.
The room stayed where it was.
Susie pushed something onto his plate.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I didn't ask for cake.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's not how that works.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “It is in this house.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=all]] “I hate all of you.”
That was the part Kiro had been trying not to think about.
The little black bag Kiro had seen in Susie's room.
[[speech speaker=susie to=martin]] “You didn't even move it.”
[[speech speaker=martin to=susie]] “You weren't supposed to look.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=martin]] “It was on my desk.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=martin]] “You put it directly in the middle of my desk.”
Inside was an old camera strap.
Kiro watched her run her thumb along the edge.
[[speech speaker=martin to=susie]] “Thought yours looked like it was about to snap.”
Her aunt gave her a sweater and a gift card.
The boyfriend gave her a bottle of something Kiro didn't recognize.
He placed the open gift bag directly into Susie's lap.
[[speech speaker=susie to=rin]] “Did you eat some of this?”
Inside was a small metal keychain.
But detailed enough that the lens actually moved.
Susie turned it between her fingers.
[[speech speaker=rin to=susie]] “Okay good or okay shit?”
She attached it to the zipper of her camera bag.
Rin tried not to look pleased.
His present was beside his leg.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You don't have to look terrified.”
The wrapping paper made a quiet sound beneath her paws.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=rin]] “Because you said it was fine.”

runs.text: Why the fuck do you care about the paper?

paragraphs: The dark album appeared beneath it.
Kiro rubbed his thumb against his sleeve.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You've got all those photos.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You can put things in this.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “That's generally what albums are for.”
Susie kept turning the empty pages.
Every page brought her closer to the middle.
He hadn't expected her to flip through the whole thing now.
What else was she supposed to do?
Kiro knew roughly where the photograph was.
He could feel his heartbeat in his throat now.
His eyes moved from Kiro to the album.
Kiro immediately gave him a look.
A white edge was visible between the black pages.
Caught somewhere between annoyed and amused.
He still wasn't looking at her.
Susie looked back at the photo.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “It doesn't have to stay here.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “It's your album. You can take it out.”
Susie held the Polaroid between two fingers.
Then at one of the empty pages near the middle.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Anything to stick these in with?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I work with records. We have archival shit.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You're such a fucking nerd.”
She slid the Polaroid carefully back where she'd found it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You don't want to move it?”
Something moved strangely inside his chest.
Susie rested the album against her legs.
Susie's aunt wanted another piece of cake.
Rin tried to steal more candy and got his paw slapped away.
For the first time all day, there was nothing left to prepare for.
Susie placed the album beside her.
Exactly where Kiro had left it.

chapters.title: First
paragraphs: The birthday slowly started falling apart.
Her boyfriend followed with two pieces of cake wrapped badly in foil.
Rin stayed another twenty minutes, mostly because he kept finding more food.
Then Martin looked at the clock.
[[speech speaker=martin to=rin]] “You planning to move in?”
Kiro was still on the couch.
Susie sat on the floor beside the coffee table, going through some of the things she'd gotten.
Something inside him dropped slightly when he said it.
Kiro stood and reached for his jacket.
His paw stopped halfway into one sleeve.
Kiro finished pulling the jacket on.
Rin had already reached the front door.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You can stay a little longer.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “Fine. I'm leaving before this gets disgusting.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=kiro]] “Text me when you're home.”
[[speech speaker=rin to=susie]] “And hide the snacks from your dad.”
Martin was still moving around in the kitchen.
Kids could still be heard outside every few minutes.
But compared to before the house suddenly felt much smaller.
Kiro stood near the door with his jacket already on.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You can take that off again.”
Kiro hung the jacket back up.

runs.text: She could've just let you leave.

paragraphs: [[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You're talking to nothing again.”
Kiro followed her back toward the living room.
She grabbed a bowl of leftover candy and nodded toward the porch.
A few groups of kids were still moving between houses.
Orange lights moved slightly in the cold wind.
They sat on the porch steps.
Susie put the bowl between them.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You've been here ten seconds.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I helped pay for some of this emotionally.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You ate part of my gift earlier.”
For a while, they watched people pass.
A little skeleton walked by holding his mother's hand.
Two older kids argued about whether one house had better candy than another.
Somebody farther down the street screamed because a decoration moved unexpectedly.
Susie leaned back against the step behind her.
After a while, she reached beside herself.
Kiro hadn't noticed her bring it outside.
She already had a few pictures.
One of her aunt making a terrible face.
One blurry photo of Rin stealing something from the kitchen.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “When did you take that?”
Rin was halfway through turning toward the camera with food in his mouth.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You need to send me that.”
Kiro looked at the pages again.
The first page was still empty.
For some reason, he noticed that.
Then she reached beside the album and picked up her instant camera.
The street noise seemed quieter for a second.
She was already adjusting the camera.
Then looked at him like the question was strange.
No good place to set the camera.
A second later the door opened.
Martin stepped outside holding a trash bag.
Susie and Kiro both turned toward him.
[[speech speaker=susie to=martin]] “You don't even know what we're asking.”
[[speech speaker=martin to=susie]] “I know exactly what you're asking.”
Martin put the trash bag down.
Susie sighed and handed it over.
There was a noticeable gap between them.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You know you're allowed to stand next to me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I am next to you.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “There's a fucking highway between us.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=martin]] “Whose side are you on?”
Susie looked at the remaining space.
Kiro's body stiffened for half a second.
Then, carefully, she lifted one arm and put it around his back.
Susie was trying not to laugh.
The camera spat the photo out.
Susie immediately took her arm away.
Martin grabbed the trash bag again.
As he passed Kiro, he said quietly:
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Why is everyone in this family like this?”
She held the developing Polaroid between both paws.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “What if I look terrible?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Then I'll cut you out.”
Kiro looking toward her instead of camera.
His expression in the photo was...
Not something he'd practiced in a mirror.
Kiro's thumb moved lightly along the white edge.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I think I like it.”
Kiro expected her to put it aside until it finished developing.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “That's usually where the first photo goes.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You already have other ones.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's not what I mean.”
For the first time that evening, Susie looked slightly unsure.
She glanced down at the photo.
Susie rubbed one finger along the edge.
She looked out toward the street.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And I wanted one with you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You're saying that to me?”
They sat outside longer than they meant to.
The last groups of kids disappeared.
Porch lights started switching off one by one.
The candy bowl became mostly wrappers and things neither of them liked.
Susie found one chocolate at the bottom.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You just fought me for this.”
Kiro looked toward the album beside her.
The first page was still open.
Warm porch light reflected faintly across it.
This time she didn't ask him to stay.
Susie picked up the album and candy bowl.
The house had gone almost completely quiet.
For a second, neither of them said anything.
For half a second, Kiro thought she was going to say something.
That almost made Kiro freeze harder than before.
His paws stayed at his sides.
Her arms settled around him again.
Kiro could feel her hair against his cheek.
The hug lasted only a few seconds.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Text me when you got home.”
The door stayed open until he reached the sidewalk.
Susie stood there for a moment.
The album was still in her arm.
She carried it back into the living room.
Kiro looking at her instead of the camera.
Susie smiling because he'd been complaining.
She stared at it for a while.
She still hadn't found the other picture hidden somewhere in the middle.

chapters.title: Lonely dance
paragraphs: His jacket came off somewhere near the entrance.
One shoe made it halfway across the living room.
The other stayed near the door.
He stared at the first step.
Five minutes later, he was asleep on the couch.
One leg hanging off the side.
His tail was trapped underneath him.
He found his phone underneath the couch cushion.
Kiro connected it to the speakers.

runs.text: Song: “Lonely Dance” by Set It Off

paragraphs: The first sound filled the room.
Then pushed it all the way up.
Something small on one of the shelves moved dangerously close to the edge.
He lowered the volume one step.
Just singing because he knew it.
His voice disappeared into the music anyway.
He moved through the living room.
A stupid little bounce when the rhythm changed.
He sang while cleaning yesterday's mug.
Nearly dropped a plate when he turned too quickly.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=reader]] “We don’t talk about that.”
For half a second, the house became quiet.
That was most of his day.
At some point, he changed from his sleep sweater into an oversized shirt because he was sweating.
One ear stayed folded strangely for almost an hour.
Kept singing under his breath when another song started.
Then louder when he knew that one too.
Sometimes he returned to this one.
His lonely dance became increasingly stupid.
No worrying whether his clothes looked right.
Just Kiro moving through his own little house until he was breathless and laughing at himself.
At one point, he caught his reflection in the dark television screen.
By evening, the sky outside had turned dark.
Kiro lay upside down across the couch.
One couch cushion was on the floor.
His breakfast plate was still on the table.
Silence slowly filled the house again.
For once, the quiet didn't immediately become something else.
Kiro reached blindly toward his phone.
His foot moved slightly to the beat.

chapters.title: Else
paragraphs: A few days after Kiro's very loud day alone, Susie asked if he wanted coffee.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “It tastes close enough without trying to fucking kill me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Caffeine isn't trying to kill you.”
Cold wind moved through the street.
Wet leaves scraped along the pavement.
They had been sitting outside the café for almost an hour.
Some old movie Susie thought was good.
She kicked his shoe lightly under the table.
A dog stood beside the table.
[[speech speaker=unknown to=susie]] “Haven't seen you in forever.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=unknown]] “Yeah. It's been a while.”
Kiro looked down at his grain coffee.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Jamie and I used to work together.”
Then they started talking about a concert.
Then they started mentioning people he didn't know.
Something stupid that happened years ago.
Memories that had nothing to do with him.
Jamie leaned against the empty chair beside her.
Kiro's paws tightened around his cup.
Something hot moved through Kiro's chest.
Jamie touched Susie's shoulder while laughing.
His claws pressed lightly into the cardboard sleeve.
She could talk to whoever she wanted.
None of that belonged to Kiro.
So why did he want Jamie to leave?
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] Sorry, I don't have the energy today.
Kiro remembered saying it was okay.
Then opening Discord three minutes later.
Another gray icon beside her name.
Jamie did something with his paws while telling another story.
Kiro wasn't hearing any of it.
[[message speaker=kiro to=ex]] Do you wanna watch something tonight?
He pressed one paw against it beneath the table.
Then his father's voice entered too.

runs.text: “Who the fuck were you talking to?”

paragraphs: His mother somewhere in their room.
He hid both paws under the table.
His father checking where she'd been.
His claw pressed into his palm.
[[message speaker=kiro to=ex]] Can we just talk for a little?
Then seeing her in voice chat with Evan.
Kiro asking less because every answer hurt.
Telling her he didn't understand what had changed.
That he wasn't asking her to stop talking to anyone.
He just wanted some time with her too.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] I need a break from talking and playing with people.
Some horrible little part of him was relieved she was looking at him instead of Jamie now.
Kiro trying to explain that he needed something too.
That he'd been trying for months.
The café disappeared for a half second.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] You pushed me away.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] This is because of you.
The chair scraped loudly against the pavement.
His paw was shaking badly now.
Like his body had skipped asking permission.
And for one horrible second he saw another person instead.
Someone who had loved him too.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] You pushed me away.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I can't do this again.”
His whole body felt full of electricity.
That was the only clear thought left.

runs.text: Before he asks for too much.
Before she looks at him one day and tells him the same thing.

paragraphs: [[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] You pushed me away.
Someone shouted when he almost ran into them.
Kiro moved around them without stopping.
His heart hammered against his ribs.
His legs moved before his thoughts could catch them.
Kiro jumped backward just enough to miss the front of the car.
He couldn't tell if it was tears or wind.
He nearly slipped on wet leaves.
He could run the entire fucking way.
Because she realized chasing him was making him run harder.
Jamie had followed part of the way but stopped behind her.
Susie stared at the empty street.
Her thumb hovered over the keyboard.
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] you don't have to explain anything right now
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] just tell me when you're home
Susie looked toward the direction he'd disappeared.
Jamie stood quietly beside her now.
[[speech speaker=jamie to=susie]] “Was that because of me?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=jamie]] “No. I don't think so.”
Neither of them really knew what else to say.
Susie looked at her phone again.
Kiro reached home barely able to breathe.
His paws shook so badly he missed the lock twice.
The key scraped against the door.
Tears still running down his face.
For several seconds, there were no thoughts.
Months of telling himself not to be controlling.
Until he'd finally asked for something.
And she'd told him it was his fault.
He slowly pulled it from his pocket.
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] you don't have to explain anything right now
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] just tell me when you're home
Kiro pressed the phone against his forehead.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] This is because of you.
His thumbs shook over the keyboard.
No demand that he explain himself.
Susie had wanted to know he was safe.
He leaned his head back against the door.
His father's paws came into his mind.
Always making his fear belong to somebody else.
[[message speaker=kiro to=ex]] can we spend some time together?
Not telling her to leave Evan.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] You pushed me away.
He didn't know what was true anymore.
Only what it had felt like.
And what it still felt like now.
His phone stayed in his paw.
Susie's message remained on the screen.
This time he didn't send it.
He just sat against the door until his breathing finally stopped hurting.

chapters.title: Floor
paragraphs: Kiro didn't answer Susie's last message.
At first, she left it alone.
He had asked for space without actually asking for space.
Susie sat on the edge of her bed.
The way he had looked at her before leaving.
One small light was on somewhere inside.
Susie stood at the front door and knocked.
Through the window, somewhere inside the house, she heard something vibrate.
Susie ran around the side of the house.
She had never smelled it on him before, even on Rin's birthday.
Kiro lay on his side beside the couch.
Susie's heart stopped for one horrible second.
Then she saw his chest move.
Kiro's paw was nowhere near it.
She got the weapon away from him first.
Only then did she kneel beside him.
Like he didn't recognize the room at first.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “What are you doing here?”
Susie caught him before his head hit the couch.
The answer came sharper than she meant.
His breath smelled faintly of alcohol.
Kiro followed her eyes toward the bottle.
His eyes moved around the room.
He saw where the gun had been.
Saw that it wasn't there anymore.
For the first time, something like fear appeared.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't think I was.”
Not until he moved closer himself.
Kiro's voice came muffled through his paws.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I bought it a long time ago.”
Susie looked toward where she'd moved it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “He didn't know where I lived.”
Kiro rubbed one paw over the other.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I kept thinking maybe he'd find out.”
Susie didn't let him escape the question.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you take it out because you were scared of your dad?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I was scared of myself.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I didn't trust my head anymore.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I kept thinking about things I didn't want to think about.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And I knew where it was.”
He looked toward where the gun had been.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So I took it out.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know if I wanted to do something or if I just...”
He pressed both paws against his face.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I think I wanted to know it was there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And then that scared me even more.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Because I was the reason it was there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I wasn't scared someone was going to hurt me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I was scared I might.”
The room suddenly felt too small.
Then toward the other side of the room.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you want to die?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I really don't fucking know.”
A tear moved down his face.
Kiro rubbed both paws over his face.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I drank because I wanted my head to shut up.”
Susie looked at the bottle again.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I still fucking drank it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I kept thinking about yesterday.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I kept thinking I was going to fuck this up.”
The words came out before he could stop them.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I shouldn't have said this.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Because that's the fucking problem.”
He had no idea what he needed.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And fucking hate that I do.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want it to turn into something bad.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to get jealous.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to need too much.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want you to start feeling like you have to explain where you are.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Or who you're talking to.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Or fucking reassure me every time somebody looks at you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to be him.”
He didn't need to say it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Jamie didn't even do anything.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And I still wanted him gone.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Maybe that's how it starts.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then making it somebody else's problem.”
A tear dropped onto his paw.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to hurt you.”
Susie looked toward the place where the gun had been.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You keep talking about everyone else.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If you don't want to hurt people, you don't get to pretend you don't count.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Doesn't really feel the same.”
Susie seemed to realize what she'd said only after it was already out.
Kiro glanced toward the other side of the room.
He rubbed one paw against his jeans.
The word seemed difficult for him.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I thought I fucked everything up.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I can't talk about it right now.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You don't want to know?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But you just said you can't.”
That seemed to affect him more than the question would have.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She told me it was my fault.”
Kiro continued before she could say anything.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's all I can do right now.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I still think I do.”
Susie didn't tell him he was wrong.
For a while, neither of them spoke.
Then Susie looked toward the bottle.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Why didn't you call me?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I ran away from you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I cried in front of you because some guy touched your shoulder.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You were crying about more than that.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And when I like someone, everything gets...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I get scared of telling people what I feel.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I tell someone I miss them.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I tell someone something hurts.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I say I'm scared they're leaving.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then I'm the reason they leave.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So sometimes it's easier to just...”
Susie's eyes moved again toward the other side of the room.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I looked through your window and thought you were dead.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Don't apologize again for five seconds.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm not angry because you like me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm not angry because you got jealous.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm fucking terrified because I came here and found you asleep beside a loaded gun.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And you just told me you were scared of yourself.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Do you understand why that scares me?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You keep saying yeah like...”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I don't want to come here one day and be too late.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know what I'm doing anymore.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know what I feel.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know if I'm scared.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Or if I still miss somebody who treated me like shit.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know if I'm actually a bad person or if somebody just told me that enough times.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And I don't know how to like you.”
He pressed his paw against his eyes.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I know I like you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I just don't know how to do that without being fucking terrified of it.”
For once, she didn't have an immediate answer.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I finally tell you and now you're thinking.”
Despite everything, Susie's mouth moved slightly.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Not because you like me.”
Kiro stopped breathing for a second.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Not because you were jealous.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm scared because you were alone with that.”
This time she let him say it.
Enough that Kiro could move away if he wanted.
Kiro leaned against her almost immediately.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And tomorrow, we're figuring out what happens with that gun.”
Kiro's eyes moved toward the other side of the room.
Kiro rested his head against her shoulder.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You said you like me.”
Her own face had gone slightly warm now.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I don't know what I want to call this yet.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Don't make me say it again.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I've had a really fucking confusing day.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to hurt you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And I don't want you to feel responsible for me.”
She adjusted slightly beneath his weight.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm staying because I want to.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Not because you're my job.”
He fell asleep against her shoulder.
She looked across the room once.
Toward the thing she'd moved away from him.
Susie rested her head lightly against his.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm still fucking pissed at you.”
She closed her eyes for a moment.
Not while that thing was still in the house.

chapters.title: Morning
paragraphs: Kiro woke with his neck hurting.
Susie sat beside him on the floor, her head resting against the cushion behind her.
For a few seconds, he didn't remember why she was there.
His eyes moved across the living room.
Like she hadn't really been asleep.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You deserve a little bit of that.”
He pulled the blanket closer around himself.
He hadn't drunk enough for that.
Kiro looked toward the bottle again.
Then his eyes moved toward the other side of the room.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Somewhere you're not getting it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'm not asking because I want to.”
Kiro rubbed his thumb against his palm.
He looked toward where it had been beside him last night.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want it here anymore.”
Kiro continued before he could change his mind.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I bought it because I thought it would make me feel safer.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “What do you want me to say?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You said you don't want it here.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “So, we'll figure out how to get it out of here safely.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I woke up and the first thing I did was check if it was still in the room.”
He pulled his knees slightly closer.
Still sitting in the exact same clothes.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You've been here all night.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And you slept for an hour?”
Susie looked at him like the question was stupid.
Then realized he genuinely didn't understand.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I was scared you'd wake up before me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I kept thinking if I fall asleep properly...”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I didn't know what you'd do when you woke up.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And I didn't know if you'd still be...”
Susie leaned her head back against the couch.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Start crying because I'm tired.”
Susie had sat beside him all night because she was afraid he might die if she slept.
There wasn't really a way to make that smaller.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I didn't mean to do that to you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I didn't want you to be scared.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I keep doing things you have to say 'I know' to.”
Susie shifted her back against the couch.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “My spine is fucking ruined.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Then put it where people have emotional disasters.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's going to require a lot of rugs.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You just rolled the one thing that's going to hurt for the rest of your life.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “What the fuck are you talking about?”
Kiro adjusted the blanket around himself.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Everyone gets one when they turn twenty-five.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You're twenty-five now. Your knees cracked. It's decided.”
Susie looked down at her knees.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “For the rest of my life?”
Kiro slowly touched the side of his neck.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You are three months older than me.”
The question came out too quickly.
Kiro watched until she disappeared into the kitchen.
He hated that he had to tell himself.
The blanket slipped slightly from his shoulder.
A minute later, Susie returned with two glasses.
Kiro drank almost all of it immediately.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Stop apologizing for drinking water.”
That got another tired laugh from her.
She sat on the couch this time.
After a moment, Susie nudged his shoulder with her knee.
The blanket stayed around his shoulders.
Susie looked toward the coffee table.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “We should get rid of that too.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You're making this suspiciously easy.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to look at it.”
Closed his eyes for a second.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You stayed awake because of me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So I'm not going to sleep while you sit here.”
She pulled one leg onto the couch.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “We both stay awake and feel like shit.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Do you regret coming here?”
He gestured vaguely at the room.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Do you regret saying it?”
She made him say it anyway.
Kiro rubbed the edge of the blanket between his fingers.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Do you regret saying it?”
Then he looked surprised at himself.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'm scared I said it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I've wanted to tell you.”
Kiro's entire body seemed to reject the question.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I changed my mind. I hate you.”
But this time it didn't hurt.
Susie let him hide for a moment.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “We need to talk about last night eventually.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't know if I can tell you all of it.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You don't have to tell me all of it.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Then tell me what you can.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You make everything sound easy.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Nothing about this is fucking easy.”
After another few minutes, Susie's head slowly tipped sideways.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You said we're staying awake.”
Her head settled against his shoulder.
Not because he didn't want it.
Morning light moved through the curtains.
The bottle still stood across from him.
Then toward the place where the gun had been.
But neither was beside him now.
Kiro carefully pulled part of the blanket over her too.
He looked at her tired face.
She had stayed awake all night because she didn't trust him to wake up alone.
But there was something else inside it too.
Someone had been afraid of losing him.
He rested his head lightly against hers.
Still scared of what had happened.
But for now, he stayed awake.
Just until she didn't have to.

chapters.title: Story
paragraphs: Four days passed before Kiro agreed to talk about it.
Susie knew that because she'd been there for both.
She hadn't trusted him to deal with either alone that morning.
After that, Susie finally went home.
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] your plant insult privileges are suspended for 24 hours
Kiro had stared at the message.
Things became almost normal again after that.
Susie sent him pictures of her dying plant.
Kiro continued insulting it once his privileges were restored.
Nothing about what Kiro had admitted on the floor.
Or what Susie had said back.
Neither of them pretended it hadn't happened.
In the way Kiro stared at her messages slightly too long.
In the way Susie sometimes added a heart and Kiro immediately put his phone face-down like it had personally attacked him.
And there was still one thing he'd promised.
Twenty minutes before Susie was supposed to arrive, Kiro was already trying to escape.
[[message speaker=kiro to=susie]] can we do this another day
[[message speaker=kiro to=susie]] I changed my mind
Susie was sitting on the front steps when he opened the door.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I was considering pretending I'm not home.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I saw you through the window.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You need to stop doing that.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You need to use your curtains.”
For half a second, both of them looked toward the living room floor.
The place where she'd found him.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You know you don't actually have to tell me today.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Don't tell me what to do.”
He put both paws between his knees.
Kiro kept his eyes on the floor.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's probably why it mattered so much.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Nobody really found me somewhere and decided they wanted to talk to me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'd commissioned some art from someone. They posted it and tagged me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She found me through that.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Basically that she saw me there and, for some reason, thought she'd message me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I thought it was weird.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And then we barely fucking talked.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Every two or three days.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then one night she messaged me differently.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She asked if I could listen to her.”
Kiro rubbed his thumb against his other paw.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We weren't anything back then.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “He'd done it before. Two days. Maybe three.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “But that time it had been a week.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She kept saying she thought something happened to him.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That she didn't know what she'd do if he did.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That maybe he'd hurt himself.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That she didn't know what she'd do if he had.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I tried calming her down.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I had no fucking idea what I was doing.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That it was probably okay.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That she shouldn't assume the worst.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then she disappeared for over an hour.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “When she came back, she was completely different.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She'd found out where he was.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “At some girl's eighteen birthday party.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “After disappearing for a week?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She'd been losing her mind worrying about him.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Maybe she needed somebody else to see it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She told me she was going to kill herself.”
Kiro continued before she could say something.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “No wondering if I was overreacting.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I needed her to stay there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then her boyfriend told her he'd never loved her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “He said he was only with her because she wanted it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I remember reading that and feeling like somebody hit me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Which didn't even make sense.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I wasn't the one dating him.”
He rubbed his palms together again.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So I asked her if she wanted to voice chat.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She didn't answer at first.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I told her I'd stay there if she changed her mind.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I was about to go to bed when Discord rang.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I sat there for a second before joining.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'd never had somebody tell me they wanted to die before.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Of saying the wrong thing.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And the second I did...”
Kiro looked slightly confused by the memory.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She was crying so hard I could barely understand anything.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That she didn't have to be afraid.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Same things over and over.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We stayed there for maybe an hour.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And around two in the morning...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I told her I liked her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I told her I felt really comfortable with her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And that I liked her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “For a while, that was probably the happiest I'd ever been.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She fell asleep in the call.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Eventually I heard her move a little and realized she'd passed out.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Next morning I turned my computer on.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I joined and waited for her to wake up.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She was so fucking confused.”
For a moment, the memory didn't hurt.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “After that, we got close really fast.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Basically long-distance dates without admitting they were dates.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We told each other properly.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That we loved each other.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “For a while it was good.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I had this smaller group online.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “People I thought were friends.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I wanted her to know them too.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She was really shy about it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Didn't really want to join calls at first.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So I told her I'd be there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “After a while she got comfortable.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Because she liked your friends?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Someone I cared about getting along with people I cared about.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “One of them was Evan.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “He and I talked a lot.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We had a disgusting amount of free time.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She started spending more time with him.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I thought it was good.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then she stopped spending time with me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'd ask if she wanted to play something.”
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] Sorry, I don't really have the energy.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Next day I'd ask if she wanted to call.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We barely did anything together.”
He gave a bitter little laugh.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Eventually it was basically goodnight and I love you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And whenever I asked to do something...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And then I'd open Discord.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Sometimes three minutes after telling me she had no energy.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “She'd be sitting in voice with him.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “We were all on the same server.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So I could see it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “What games they were playing.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Which voice channel they were in.”
Kiro rubbed one paw over the other.
Kiro didn't try to defend himself.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Sometimes I'd open Discord just to see if she was there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And if she was with him...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Sometimes for way too fucking long.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'd wonder what they were talking about.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Why she'd rather be there.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Why she suddenly had energy.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Whether she was happier with him.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And then I'd hate myself for checking.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you ever tell her to stop talking to him?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Tell Evan to stay away from her?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I told him I loved her.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Try to pull her out of calls?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Sometimes seeing them made me want to message her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want to pretend I was completely normal about it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I wanted her to choose me.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “But I never told her she wasn't allowed to choose anything else.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Because every time I felt jealous...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And then I watched anyway.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Just silently made myself fucking miserable.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did she know you were watching?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you tell her you were jealous?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Eventually I told her I felt ignored.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That I needed something too.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I held it in for months before that.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Because I thought wanting time with her meant I was controlling.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That wanting to spend time with your partner was normal.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “So you talked to her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I told her I missed her.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That we hadn't done anything together in weeks.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That it was fucking with my head.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That I needed her too.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “This is because of you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Because she was the person I loved.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So if she told me I caused it...”
Susie watched him for a while.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you ever actually tell her she couldn't talk to Evan?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you tell her who she could spend time with?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Did you threaten her over him?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You checked whether she was with him.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You kept reopening Discord even though you knew it was making you feel worse.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But you weren't making her leave those calls.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You weren't telling her she could see him.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Don't make hurting yourself sound like the good version.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But sitting there checking again and again until you felt like shit wasn't healthy either.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And hurting yourself instead of somebody else doesn't make it harmless.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “What were you actually asking her for?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “That's different from deciding who she's allowed to talk to.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Both things can be true.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You can have handled parts of it badly.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Sitting there staring at their names.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Making yourself fucking sick over it.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “And she can still have hurt you.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I don't know every conversation.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm not going to pretend I know exactly why she did what she did.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But what you've told me isn't just...”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I got jealous and destroyed everything.”
That was exactly how he'd remembered it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's what it feels like.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But feelings aren't security footage.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's what happened with Jamie.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “About people I didn't know.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Things that happened before me.”
That sick feeling in his stomach.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And that scared the shit out of me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Because you thought it was starting again.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “But not just with my ex.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I thought if I let myself feel jealous...”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then I'd need to know.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then maybe telling you what to do.”
His claws pressed lightly into his jeans.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And eventually I'd look at him.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You skipped like twelve steps.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You went from Jamie touching my shoulder to eventually becoming your father.”
He gave her an exhausted look.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Have you considered becoming a therapist?”
That pulled a laugh out of him.
Then her expression became serious again.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If I need space from you, I'll tell you.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If I'm angry, I'll tell you.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If you do something that bothers me...”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But don't decide I'm already leaving when I haven't gone anywhere.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'm not looking you in the eyes and saying, 'Hello, Susan, some guy touched you and now my brain is fucking eating itself.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You nearly got hit by a car last time.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I was scared to tell you I liked you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And real things can go wrong.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “And when they do, people get hurt.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't want mine to hurt you.”
That clearly wasn't what he expected.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Sometimes because they're being fucking idiots.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I might hurt you too.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “But that doesn't mean we decide it's already ruined before anything even happens.”
Susie's paw moved onto the couch between them.
Kiro stared at her paw again.
His heart started doing stupid things.
Slowly, awkwardly, he put his paw into hers.
After a while, Kiro's thumb moved once against the side of her paw.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I still miss her sometimes.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's probably the smartest thing you've said today.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I don't think I want her back.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I miss who I was before everything went wrong.”
Susie's paw tightened slightly around his.
Kiro looked down at their paws.
Four days ago, he'd run from here because he was convinced feeling something ugly meant he would eventually destroy everything.
Later that night, Susie had found him on the floor.
The next morning, she hadn't trusted him enough to leave the alcohol or the gun for him to deal with alone.
She had been right not to.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Don't tell anyone I talked this much.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Your reputation would never recover.”
For once, Kiro let the silence stay exactly where it was.

chapters.title: After
paragraphs: The next time Kiro saw Susie, nothing terrible happened.
Just Susie standing outside a second-hand shop, looking at her phone.
They had talked for hours about his ex.
Told each other they liked each other.
And somehow saying hi now felt more intimate than any of that.
The shop smelled like old fabric and dust.
Susie immediately disappeared toward a rack of jackets.
Kiro followed at a safer distance.
He didn't really know why she had invited him.

runs.text: She wanted to spend time with him.

paragraphs: That was still something his brain occasionally refused to accept without paperwork.
Susie pulled out a brown jacket.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You look like somebody's divorced uncle.”
She put it over her arm.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You dress like a sheep.”
For a while, they just moved through the shop.
A shelf full of mugs nobody needed.
Kiro picked up one shaped like a frog.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “To you or the frog?”
They ended up at the records.
Kiro crouched beside one of the lower boxes.
Susie stood beside him, going through another.
Susie was focused on an album cover.
A few seconds later, her paw brushed his while they both reached for the same record.
Then Kiro slowly pulled his back.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I don't even want it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Then why did you grab it?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You did that on purpose.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Your face is doing something.”
Kiro looked down at the records.
They left with the ugly brown jacket.
Susie looked at the bag in Kiro's paw.
They walked without really deciding where.
The kind of weather Kiro liked.
Susie shoved her paws into her jacket pockets.
Kiro's stomach reacted before his brain did.
Susie saw something change in his face.
He rubbed the back of his neck.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Hello, Susan. You mentioned another man and now my brain is fucking eating itself.”
Kiro took another step before realizing.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You told me to fucking say it.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “For the record, I'm not going anywhere with Jamie.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “He told me about a concert.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “The one you were talking about at the café?”
Something Jamie had apparently mentioned before everything went wrong.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I was thinking about going.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I want you to come with me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Why do you always ask that?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Because I want you there.”
He looked down at the bag with the frog mug.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I've never been to one.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Please don't do the never-never thing.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Just never really had anyone to go with.”
Kiro immediately regretted how sad that sounded.
His body just forgot the next step.
Susie took two more before noticing.
Kiro rubbed one paw against the shopping bag.
His chest tightened slightly just thinking about it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Before I change my mind.”
After a few steps, their paws brushed.
This time Susie's little finger caught around his.
Kiro froze for half a second.
Then their paws settled together properly.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So, how are we getting there?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I just suddenly became concerned about the concert.”
Susie didn't let go of his paw.

chapters.title: Passenger
paragraphs: Kiro heard the truck before Susie knocked.
Just old enough to sound slightly unhappy about being alive.
He looked through the front window.
Another message appeared before he could answer.
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] and yes I can see you
Kiro stepped away from the window immediately
[[message speaker=susie to=kiro]] get in the truck
He looked down at himself once.
He'd stood in front of the closet for far too long before deciding on it.
Not because this was a date.
Kiro grabbed his jacket and left.
Kiro stopped halfway down the driveway.
A few scratches along the bed.
Small dent near the rear wheel.
Susie rolled down the passenger window.
She rested one arm against the window.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I saw it outside someone's house and decided it belonged to me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You were born before it.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You're becoming very comfortable insulting me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I've always been comfortable insulting you.”
The inside smelled faintly like old fabric, coffee, and Susie.
A green plaid jacket thrown behind hers.
A few CDs stuffed beside the center console.
Something small hanging from the mirror.
It was a tiny white ghost.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “What the fuck is that?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Why does your ghost have a cowboy hat?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You absolutely fucking named him.”
Susie pulled away from the curb.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Exactly. Put your seatbelt on.”
The little ghost swung from side to side as they drove.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “He looks like a Steve.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “So he does have a name.”
For the first few minutes, Kiro kept looking around.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “It has a CD player.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That's a point in its favor.”
Kiro opened the small compartment beside the seat.
Susie reached toward him at the next red light.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “That doesn't mean you're allowed to look.”
Kiro looked at the cover again.
He held it against his chest.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You gave up ownership through shame.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “How the fuck did you see that?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I know where they go.”
Kiro smiled and put the CD into the player.
Outside, the evening was getting darker.
Susie tapped her fingers against the steering wheel.
Then he remembered where there were going.
Kiro looked out the window again.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Maybe a hundred and fifty.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If it sucks, we go outside.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You don't have to leave because of me.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I'm not talking about leaving.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “We go back in if you want.”
At another red light, Susie leaned across him.
Her shoulder brushed against the front of his plaid shirt.
Her face was suddenly very close.
Susie held the pack toward him.
His heart remained stupid for another full minute.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You really never went to one?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Not even some tiny local thing?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That does not fucking count.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “By that logic I've been to concerts in grocery stores.”
Kiro looked back through the windshield.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I used to watch recordings sometimes.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “That's kind of the point.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Like everyone is hearing the same thing, but nobody gives a shit what anyone else is doing.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I thought that looked nice.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Being somewhere you don't have to think for a while.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Maybe you'll like it, then.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Or I'll have a panic attack in the first ten minutes.”
Traffic got heavier closer to downtown.
Kiro recognized some band shirts even though he didn't know the bands.
At the next stop, something touched it.
Susie was still watching the road.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I didn't tell you to stop.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'm trying not to embarrass myself.”
Her paw remained on his knee until traffic started moving again.
Then she returned it to the wheel.
Kiro looked out the passenger window.
Susie turned the music up slightly.
A few minutes later, Susie reached toward the center console.
Then her finger hooked around his.
Just two fingers caught together beside the gear shifter.
The city lights blurred slightly against the glass.
They stayed like that until she needed to change gears.
Then, a moment later, put her paw back.
He slowly placed his paw into hers.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “If we die, I'll apologize.”
He didn't let go until she actually needed both paws again.
Even that, she put hers back near his afterward.
They eventually turned onto a narrow street.
Kiro could already see people outside.
Someone smoking beside a brick wall.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You still want to go?”
They found parking a few streets away.
The little cowboy ghost swayed once.
People were walking in the same direction.
Red plaid shirt beneath his open jacket.
For some reason, he'd spent too long choosing it.
Now surrounded by dark band shirts and jackets outside, he wondered if he'd chosen wrong.
Her eyes moved from his shirt to his face.
Susie looked back through the windshield.
This time for a different reason.
His paws were resting in his lap.
One of them still remembered hers.
No idea what it would feel like.
Not staring at him like he was fragile.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Before I change my mind.”
He left his jacket open, the red plaid visible underneath.
Their shoulders bumped as she caught up.
The bass became clearer with every block.
A faint vibration through the pavement.
He could feel it in his chest.
But something else was starting to push against it.
He stared at the dark entrance ahead.
Then placed his paw in hers.
The words came out before he thought about them.
Kiro immediately regretted how serious they sounded.
Together, they walked toward the door.

chapters.title: Concert
paragraphs: The first thing Kiro noticed was the heat.
The second the door closed behind them, cold evening air disappeared.
And underneath all of it, bass.
Heavy enough that he felt it through the floor before he properly heard it.
Her paw was still holding his.
The venue was smaller than he'd imagined.
A narrow room opened ahead of them.
Small stage at the other end.
Most of them layered over older posters.
Maybe a hundred people already inside.
Someone brushed past Kiro from behind.
He moved closer to Susie automatically.
The opening band was already playing.
The sound was completely different from speakers at home.
Guitar filled everything between his ears.
Bass traveled through the floor and up his legs.
They were standing almost completely upright.
He couldn't hear whether she answered.
They found a place slightly off to the side.
Not trapped near the back either.
Susie had probably chosen it deliberately.
His paw was no longer on hers.
He shoved both paws into the pockets of his jacket.
The red plaid shirt underneath was already getting too warm.
He should have left the jacket in the truck.
At first, Kiro didn't know what to do with himself.
A few people near the stage jumping.
Someone behind them knew every word.
Thinking about the fact that he was standing there watching and listening.

runs.text: Everyone can tell you've never done this.

paragraphs: Then another person stepped in front of him.
Then the drummer hit something hard.
The entire room seemed to move with it.
His tail moved once behind him.
Kiro stopped watching what everyone else was doing.
For the first time since entering, he wasn't thinking about whether he belonged here.
His head moved with the rhythm.
His tail started moving properly now.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You were looking at me.”
Susie leaned closer to his ear.
Kiro looked away before his face could betray him further.
By the end of the opening set, he was sweating.
Susie took one look at his red plaid shirt.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I SAID IT LOOKS BETTER WITHOUT THE JACKET.”
Kiro tied the jacket around his waist.
Susie cupped one paw beside her ear.
The break between bands felt almost too quiet.
People talked loudly enough to compensate.
Susie handed him a bottle of water.
A smile started before he could stop it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “No, this is fucking great.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You didn't tell me it feels like getting hit by music.”
A sharp sound came through the speakers.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Why people keep doing this.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Wait until the actual band starts.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “That wasn't the actual band?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I told you there was an opener.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You told me a lot of things.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Do you listen to anything I say?”
Susie noticed him scanning the room.
The main band came out ten minutes later.
Someone pushed past his left side.
Another body crossed between him and Susie.
He tried moving toward where he'd last seen her.

runs.text: Where the fuck is the door?

paragraphs: She was pushing between two people toward him.
Kiro closed his paw around hers.
She moved them slightly farther to the side.
Away from the thickest part of the crowd.
His breathing slowly started working again.
Kiro brought his mouth closer to her ear.
Then she started to loosen her grip.
Susie looked down at their paws.
Kiro expected his head to hate it.
Instead, there wasn't enough room inside him for anything else.
[[message speaker=ex to=kiro]] You pushed me away.
Everyone was too busy being loud themselves.
A woman beside him was screaming along.
Someone farther ahead was dancing terribly.
A guy near the wall had his eyes closed the entire time.
His tail moved freely behind him.
He bounded slightly with the rhythm.
Their joined paws moved between them.
At some point Kiro forgot he was holding her.
It just became part of everything.
Kiro had no idea how many.
Time didn't feel particularly useful anymore.
During one slower song, the crowd settled slightly.
Nobody was pushing them apart now.
Kiro looked back toward the stage.
The next song was fast again.
At one point she shouted something.
Susie grabbed the front of his red plaid shirt and pulled him closer.
Kiro nearly forgot where he was.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “I SAID YOU LOOK HAPPY.”
Then she let go of his shirt.
Kiro felt his entire face heat.
The next hit of bass went straight through his chest.
For once, his heart racing didn't scare him.
The final song ended too quickly.
Kiro genuinely thought there would be another.
The band came back for one more.
When the lights finally came up properly, everything felt strange.
People started moving toward the exit.
Red plaid shirt sticking slightly to his back.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You know we're not going to get separated anymore?”
Susie looked around at the thinning crowd.
Cold air hit Kiro like water.
Trying to hear each other over ears that were probably just as destroyed as Kiro's.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “You don't have to scream anymore.”
They walked away from the entrance.
The music was still audible through the walls.
He thought about everything he'd expected.
And some of that had happened.
His thoughts disappearing beneath the music.
Nobody caring what he looked like.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I want to do that again.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “My ears need to recover.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I'm three months older than you.”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Your knees are permanently broken.”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “Your neck is permanently broken.”
The Ranger was still a few blocks away.
Their paws remained together between them.
Kiro looked down at them once.
This time he didn't overthink it.
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “I probably would've kept saying someday forever.”
Susie stayed quiet for a second.
Susie was looking straight ahead now.
Something warm moved through his chest.
They walked toward the old green Ranger together.
And underneath all of it, the music was still there.

chapters.title: Couple
paragraphs: They made it back to the Ranger.
Kiro reached for the passenger door.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “When did you last eat?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You ate breakfast and then nothing?”
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “How the fuck do you forget food?”

Kiro stared through the windshield at the bright sign.
[[speech speaker=susie to=kiro]] “You want to keep starving?”
[[speech speaker=kiro to=susie]] “Hot dogs suddenly sound incredible.”
